answer: Because the ridge weight is recomputed from the sonnet history each close, the marble audit reveals the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm hence buys partial influence at full price for every alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. A new identity spends its first 4 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 23% of full weight. That is 32 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
